items.title: 10.17.1 Direction of electron flow (electrons kis taraf behte hain) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.17.1, printed page 231.

blocks.text: Electrochemical cell ke do half-cells ki E° values ka muqabla kar ke bahar ke circuit ki taaron mein electrons ke flow ki direction (simt) maloom ki ja sakti hai. Misal ke taur par Figure 10.9 mein yeh voltages hain:

In values ka muqabla batata hai ke Zn²⁺ ions Ag⁺ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain. Is liye Zn metal Ag⁺/Ag half-cell ko electrons deta hai aur Ag⁺ ions Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell se electrons lete hain. Electrons sirf bahar ke circuit ki taaron mein chalte hain, electrolyte solution mein se nahi guzarte. Yani electrons ka flow Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell se Ag⁺/Ag half-cell ki taraf hai — negative pole se positive pole ki taraf. Yaad rakhein: zyada positive pole negative electrons ko apni taraf kheenchta hai.

blocks.caption: Electron flow
rows: negative pole (zyada negative E°, jaise Zn²⁺/Zn −0.76 V)
positive pole (zyada positive E°, jaise Ag⁺/Ag +0.80 V)
positive pole electrons kheenchta hai; electrons sirf taaron mein chalte hain

blocks.prompt: Fe²⁺/Fe (−0.44 V) aur Cu²⁺/Cu (+0.34 V) ke cell mein electrons kis taraf behte hain?
blocks.explanation: Iron ka E° zyada negative hai, is liye iron negative pole hai: electrons taar mein iron electrode se copper electrode ki taraf behte hain. Iron par oxidation (Fe → Fe²⁺ + 2e⁻) aur copper par reduction (Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu) hoti hai.

items: Electrons bahar ki taaron mein zyada negative E° wale half-cell (negative pole) se zyada positive E° wale (positive pole) ki taraf behte hain; electrolyte mein se nahi.
